openaiSpec.name: query_excel_data
openaiSpec.description: Query a locally loaded Excel file using DuckDB SQL. The table name is always excel_data. Column names must be quoted exactly as they appear in the schema (example: "Fecha", "Area", "Total TEUs"). Never ask the user to paste the spreadsheet. Never invent column names: call action=schema first if you are unsure. Only SELECT/WITH queries are allowed. Results are computed locally in the browser; you receive a small JSON summary, not the full file.

action.description: schema: list columns and types. preview: first 10 rows. query: run the SQL in the sql parameter.

sql.description: DuckDB SQL against excel_data. Required when action is query. Use quoted identifiers for every column. Prefer aggregations, LIMIT, and GROUP BY so the JSON stays small.

max_rows.description: Maximum rows to return to the model. Default 200, maximum 500.
